tspan.tspan: Compute an estimated unit price from material, dimensions,
and machining conditions, then confirm it. Only a confirme
d price estimate can be used as the price list's base.
For each customer × product, set prices by order type and q
uantity tier.
The unit price is auto-filled from the price list. Submit the i
ssued PDF to the customer.
A purchase order arrives by fax, PDF, etc.
Check and correct the imported extraction result.
The order's price is automatically matched against the quot
e and price list.
Either go back to the quote to fix the price, or correct and re
check the price on the order acceptance side.
Once the content is finalized, request approval. It cannot b
e edited while the request is pending.
Apply the feedback, fix the content, and request approval a
gain.
An order line is created per line item and the amount is fina
lized. Production flow proceeds from here.
For products without a drawing, a design request is filed in
parallel with this flow, and production creates the drawing.

svg.text: Sales flow — From price estimate to order confirmation
